title: Large Air-con Ledges and Balconies at Non-Landed Residential Properties
what_it_is: Large Air-con Ledges and Balconies at Non-Landed Residential Properties

sections.label: Air-conditioner ledges and balconies GFA
sections.summary: Air-conditioner ledges below one metre wide are exempted from GFA, while balconies are not exempted and incur development charge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For example, air-conditioner ledges below one metre in width are exempted from GFA in order to incentivise developers to house air-conditioner condensers neatly in residential developments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Balconies, on the other hand, are, in fact, not exempted from GFA, and developers must pay development charge for them.

sections.label: Balcony and ledge area disclosure
sections.summary: Balconies and air-conditioner ledges are strata area chargeable to buyers, and developers must already disclose floor plans and area breakdowns before the booking fee.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As both balconies and air-conditioner ledges solely serve individual units, they are considered to be strata area and, hence, chargeable to the buyer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It is already mandatory for developers to provide prospective home buyers with a drawn-to-scale floor plan of the unit and, a detailed breakdown of the area of the unit by various types of spaces, such as bedrooms, bathrooms, air-conditioner ledges and balconies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Member had suggested making this mandatory; it is already the case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This information must be given to prospective home buyers before they pay the booking fee for an Option to Purchase (OTP) for the unit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The floor area of various types of spaces, including air-conditioner ledges and balconies, must also be accurately represented in the show-flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: URA will not hesitate to take action against developers who have misrepresented such information to home buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: As I understand it, there is this Balcony Bonus Gross Floor Area (GFA) scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: It provides the developers a bonus to build up to 10% more than the allowable GFA.
